role: ブラウザー用フィルターの公開配布元（release authority）

heads.note: 最新の main head は `git rev-parse origin/main` で確認してください。以下は記録値です。

historical.PUBLICATION_HOLD: active: Release作成・公開範囲変更・購読URL変更は所有者承認まで保留
historical.NO_NEW_INTERNAL_PUSH: active: main への直接 push 禁止（作業ブランチへの push と PR 作成は可）

protection.main_ruleset: Ruleset 'main protection': PR必須（承認0）・必須チェック test / engine（Filter list checks）・non-fast-forward禁止・削除禁止。2026-11-04 の履歴書き換え時のみ一時無効化し、同一設定で復元済み
protection.ci_zip_guard: Filter list checks の test ジョブで追跡中の *.zip / *.7z を検出すると FAIL

downstream.pinned_import: faaff/ai/imports/s.json（取り込み対象ファイルに実差分がある場合のみ faaff 側で別PRを作成して検証）
downstream.sync_rule: Check the exact faaff/ai/imports/s.json excluded_paths. The current excluded paths include AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, ai/HANDOFF.md, and ai/PROJECT_STATE.json; do not generalize to all ai/*.

open_items: 2026-11-04: RPLAY_*.zip 10件を git-filter-repo で全ブランチ履歴から削除済み（main 6827b08 -> 74e9f27、ツリー同一）。旧コミット 2a99e89 / dd435a2 等は閉じた/merge済みPRの refs/pull/* 経由で GitHub 上に残存。所有者が GitHub Support へキャッシュ削除を依頼予定（未完了）
LICENSE ファイル未配置（ライセンスは各フィルターのヘッダーで宣言: v2/* は GPL-3.0-only、その他 CC0-1.0）
has_wiki / has_projects が有効（未使用と推定）
Actions に main に無いワークフロー登録が残存: Validate v2 filters, GPT1 workspace preflight, GPT1 Actions lock pilot（2026-11-04 に disable 済み）、Filter Python 3.14/3.15 compatibility（proposal ブランチ由来）

governance.authority: AGENTS.md on current main; re-read exact main/PR HEAD and checks before each change
governance.scope: Autonomous research, method selection, multilingual research, implementation and tests only within authorized permissions
governance.approval_gate: SUPERSEDED 2026-11-04: under Operating policy v3 AI may merge its own green, revertible PRs (tools/safe_merge.sh); owner approval only for force-push/history rewrite on main, repo deletion, production deploys, making anything public, money/credentials
governance.continuation: News monitoring observes material AI changes; existing development quality audit checks applicability. Neither guarantees automatic memory synchronization or unattended commits.
governance.production_impact: No release, product runtime, public filter path, subscription URL, deployment, or distribution changed by the governance merge
governance.verification_note: PR test/engine successful; post-merge docs-only push is excluded from s workflow push paths

governance_current: AGENTS.md -> Operating policy v3 (2026-11-04); newest dated policy wins
